## Workload

Lena Fischer completed the grading workload during 364 rostered hours. A total of 725 sets were graded, representing a rate of 2.0 per hour. The workload was recorded for review to support routine monitoring of grading activity and the time required to complete the assigned work.

The review considered the reported output alongside the available working hours. This provided a clear basis for assessing throughput and identifying any matters requiring follow-up.

## Quality

A sample of 66 sets was read again as part of the quality check. Agreement was recorded at 69.7 per cent. The check included borderline background cases, and feedback was provided where the grading required clarification or further consideration.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The findings should be considered alongside the workload information and used to support continued consistency in grading practice.
